correctness.rationale: The characteristic-seven polynomial f=x(x^9+x^6+a x^3+b) has squarefree condition b*Delta≠0 and degree10, hence genus four; the cube-root automorphism has elliptic quotient. Independently reconstructed the characteristic-seven Cartier coefficient matrix, whose block decomposition has determinant 3b²uv², with u=a³+6ab+3b² and v=3a(a+1)-b. On v=0, b=3a(a+1), u=-a²(a+2)² and Delta=2a(a+2)^3, so the two Hasse components do not meet in the smooth locus. The 2x2 rank-one block has stable rank zero exactly when ab²+(a+1)^7=0; its restriction factors as (a+1)^2(2a³+(a+1)^5), and the quintic factors (a-2)(a-3)(a³+3a²-1) over F7. The five nonboundary roots give Prym rank0 with the geometric parameter count 2+3; all four Jacobian (a-number, rank) strata and no Prym rank2 follow. Symbolic checks confirm these identities; direct algebraic semilinear reasoning, not finite-field samples, supplies the all-geometric-parameter proof.
residual_risks: Prym ranks are for connected Prym kernel up to prime-to-7 isogeny, not isomorphism classification.
